text:
rachel: Heads-up — new POC with VitaHealth. They want Redwood Private with an Interface VPCE (us-west-2) and a tiny Dedicated pool. They listed VPC 10.30.0.0/16 and three private subnets. Can we give a compact pre-check + common failure points?

tom: Compact pre-check (share with customer):
1) Make sure an Interface VPCE to our Endpoint Service exists in the workload VPC (if TGW/peering in use, recommend VPCE in the same VPC).
2) Enable Private DNS on the VPCE if you want api.redwood.internal to resolve to ENIs.
3) VPCE security group: allow inbound TCP 443 from the VPC CIDR; outbound allow ephemeral ports / 443.
4) Ensure private subnets have egress (NAT/GW) or routes to reach image registry and onboarding endpoints.
5) Check Route53 Resolver rules/firewall that could rewrite internal names.

aditi: Quick CLI checks to ask them to paste before our call:
- aws ec2 describe-vpc-endpoints --filters Name=vpc-id,Values=vpc-xxxxx --region us-west-2
- aws ec2 describe-route-tables --filters Name=vpc-id,Values=vpc-xxxxx --region us-west-2
- aws ec2 describe-nat-gateways --filter Name=vpc-id,Values=vpc-xxxxx --region us-west-2
- dig +short private-api.redwood.internal

rachel: Common gotchas to call out: missing NAT so bootstrap times out, private DNS disabled so hostname resolves publicly, SGs/NACLs blocking ephemeral ports, and assuming VPC peering reaches interface endpoints (it doesn't).

infra-bot: infra/checklist-runner #77 completed — provider NLB healthy.

tom: For security q/a: say that for Private we use a bootstrap token exchange and customer-scoped keys (KMS-wrapped if requested). Control-plane traffic can remain on PrivateLink when configured; otherwise it egresses over TLS to allowlisted endpoints.

aditi: If VitaHealth sees curl timeout, ask: what does dig return? If ENI IPs -> SG/NACL/NAT; if public IP -> private DNS not enabled or resolver forwarding.

rachel: I'll schedule a 15-min pre-check tomorrow 09:30 PT. Please ask them to paste the CLI outputs above + their VPCE SG rules. Tom/aditi can you join?

tom: I'll join. aditi: I'll be there.

rachel: Great — I'll post the outputs here before the call. Thanks :pray:
